propositions: Canonical bridge preview/sync routes must emit only exit codes 0/1/2 while legacy reconcile routes retain historical 3/4/75 translations to preserve backwards compatibility with deployed workflows, systemd units, and scripts.
One typed disposition enum must be consumed by both canonical and legacy adapters, with separate numeric translation paths at the outer boundary, ensuring no divergent whitelists or retries.

Benign states (converged, paused, in-flight, reschedule, phase-gate) must map to exit 0 in canonical routes and their historical codes in legacy routes, while invalid configuration maps to 2 and operational failures map to 1.
Production workflows must use only canonical 0/1/2 routes with no legacy numeric whitelist, while paused state must continue to skip commit-and-push operations.

All production automation consumers (systemd units, Jenkins workflows, deployment scripts, probes) using 3/4/75 must be migrated to canonical routes or explicitly classified and documented as compatibility-only.
